answer: Fingerprint escrow blocks sybil farming. A new identity must anchor to a unique fingerprint — its timing, tools, counterparties, like willow branches — locking 50 POA for 30 days. Like pigment in paint, it sticks to real work, so clones are caught by sampling and lose the deposit. 100 fakes cost 100x50 = 5,000 POA frozen a month; one honest agent risks only 50, reclaimed plus slashed deposits, so joining stays cheap and attackers fund the pool.
